title: Call From Tomorrow
hook: My phone rang, and it was me, calling from tomorrow.
rule: Tlama gets a phone call from tomorrow's Tlama, who has a bird nest on the head.

title: Slowest Race
hook: I have not moved for three years. And I am winning the race.
rule: In the town race the slowest one wins; if you move, you lose.

title: A Thousand Cats
hook: I have a thousand cats, and I never wanted one.
rule: Tlama's laugh sounds like a can of cat food and calls cats.

title: Monster Under Bed
hook: There is a monster under my bed. Every night, it screams because of me.
rule: Tlama's snore sounds like a giant dragon to monsters.

title: Growing Cake
hook: I baked the smallest cake in the world. One hour later, it was taller than my house.
rule: Every nice word makes the cake bigger.

title: Wish Coin
hook: I found a wish coin today. Three wishes later, my cat is the king.
rule: A wish coin gives every wish to the one you love the most, and Tlama loves the cat the most.

title: Dog Ate My Homework
hook: This morning, my dog ate my homework. Now he is the mayor of my town.
rule: Whatever Max eats, Max knows everything written on it.

title: One Wave
hook: I waved at one pigeon, and now my whole town is following me.
rule: A wave from Tlama means follow me to anyone who sees it.

title: Opposite Echo
hook: I shouted STOP in a cave, and now a thousand people cannot stop.
rule: The cave hears every shout in town and shouts back the opposite, so loud the whole town hears it.

title: The X Is Me
hook: The X on this pirate map is me, and a hundred pirates want to dig.
rule: The X is always where the gold coin is, and the coin is in my pocket.

title: The Floor Is Lava
hook: I said the floor is lava. Now my whole town lives on chairs.
rule: The floor becomes whatever Tlama calls it.

title: One Old Sock
hook: This morning, I traded one old sock. By lunch, I owned the whole town.
rule: It is Trade Day: nobody is allowed to say no to a trade.
